python3 -c "
import glom.core as core

# Test that Check still works correctly after adding repr
spec = core.Check(type=int)
result = glom(42, spec)
print('glom(42, Check(type=int)):', result)

try:
    result = glom('hello', spec)
except Exception as e:
    print('glom(\"hello\", Check(type=int)) raised:', type(e).__name__)

# Test with default
spec2 = core.Check(type=int, default=0)
result = glom('hello', spec2)
print('glom(\"hello\", Check(type=int, default=0)):', result)

# Test with validate
spec3 = core.Check(validate=lambda x: x > 0)
result = glom(5, spec3)
print('glom(5, Check(validate=...)):', result)

try:
    result = glom(-1, spec3)
except Exception as e:
    print('glom(-1, Check(validate=...)) raised:', type(e).__name__)
